primary_interfaces.title: Harvey (joint work with Park and Ray), Pure braids, Whitney towers, and0-solvability
primary_interfaces.read_extent: Entire contribution printed3020–3021, especially Question3 and preceding ordinary-derived-series definition.
primary_interfaces.interface: Classical disk pure braids as a subgroup of the string-link concordance group; ordinary derived series; Question3 asks (P_m)^(n+2)⊂F_n^m for n≥1. The n=0 statement is separately reported as prior background.
primary_interfaces.boundary: The report is numbered2017/50; EMS records final publication19December2018. This verifies the historical formulation, not continuing openness or priority.

primary_interfaces.title: Otto, The(n)-solvable filtration of link concordance and Milnor’s invariants
primary_interfaces.read_extent: §2 printed2630–2632, Definitions2.1–2.3 and the displayed filtration.
primary_interfaces.interface: Smooth ordered oriented string links and stacking/concordance; standard closure; integral H1 isomorphism, integral H2 framed embedded hyperbolic surface basis, both surface groups in the ordinary nth derived subgroup. The filtration decreases, so F_n⊂F_1 for integers n≥1.
primary_interfaces.boundary: No replacement by rational solvability, locally flat topological category, exterior cobordism, a group operation on closed links or mere signature vanishing. Definition2.3 supplies the exact solution hypothesis used.

primary_interfaces.title: Gambaudo–Ghys, Braids and Signatures
primary_interfaces.read_extent: Printed544–545 (Meyer definition, TheoremA, Remarks1–3),568–569 (§4.2 and Lemma4.1),575 (homogenization and error bound).
primary_interfaces.interface: Closure link signatures at a root of unity ω≠1; ω=−1 is allowed. On B_n the signature defect and homogenization error are bounded by2n. For B3 this is6. Remark3 gives signature1−ℓ for the two-strand positive power; the n=3 central shift is−8, giving the necessary homogeneous values. The Meyer-form interface is also available for the separate explicit certificate.
primary_interfaces.boundary: Only the n=3 specialization of the central-shift statement is used. It concerns links, not just knots. Nonzero homogenized signature does not itself assert nonzero ordinary signature for the same representative; the paper takes a positive power.

primary_interfaces.title: Calegari, scl
primary_interfaces.version: Author-hosted scl book; bibliographic reference MSJMemoirs20(2009); fetched bytes version-bound without claiming equality to finalpublisherfile
primary_interfaces.read_extent: Printed27 (amenable examples/definition) and33 (Proposition2.65 and its proof).
primary_interfaces.interface: Solvable groups are amenable; every homogeneous real quasimorphism on an amenable group is a homomorphism. The quotient G/G^(k) is solvable for finite k.
primary_interfaces.boundary: Author-hosted full book fetched and hash-bound; not claimed byte-identical to publisher’s2009 file. Only indicated passages were read. No requirement that the original braid group be amenable.

primary_interfaces.title: Kawasaki–Kimura–Maruyama–Matsushita–Mimura, The space of nonextendable quasimorphisms
primary_interfaces.read_extent: Printed1207, Lemma7.12 and full short proof; adjacent Corollary7.11 context.
primary_interfaces.interface: For homogeneous f on G and normal N with solvable quotient G/N, D_G(f)=D_N(f|N). This is stronger than the all-finite-derived-depth persistence consequence used in the manuscript.
primary_interfaces.boundary: Published16May2025; this ingredient is prior and must be credited. The manuscript also supplies a direct proof of its weaker consequence via amenable rigidity.

primary_interfaces.title: Toffoli, The Atiyah–Patodi–Singer rho invariant and signatures of links
primary_interfaces.read_extent: Equation(1.1) and surrounding introduction; Notation4.9 and Definitions4.12–4.13; Theorem4.24, relevant proof context, Remark4.25/equation(4.21), Lemma4.27/Corollary4.28 interface and Remark4.29.
primary_interfaces.interface: Bounding formula requires the unitary representation to extend. Surgery formula requires a compatible integral framing, colour-to-colour algebraic splitting and ω in(U(1)\{1})^n. For one colour and algebraically split zero-framed surgery, the entire linking matrix is zero. The all-meridian−1 character is compatible and correction terms vanish. Domain does not exclude Alexander roots.
primary_interfaces.boundary: The37-page repository PDF is the2022 published article with online-first pagination1–37; final bibliographic pages404–440 are not its printed pagination. No averaging or generic-point substitute is used.
